data.body_html:
Planning a stag weekend in Marbella? Boat rental is a highlight, and knowing the marbella boat rental stag weekend cost breakdown 2027 helps you budget without surprises. Our fleet in Puerto Banús offers everything from a quick 2-hour cruise to a full-day party. Here's exactly what you'll pay – and what you get.

Boat Rental Prices for Stag Weekends (2027)

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% IVA. No hidden fees. The table below shows the most popular options for stag groups.

For smaller groups (5–6 guests), the Boat Rental Marbella fleet includes the Speedboat (€749/2h) and Red Tide (€749/2h). All prices are per boat, not per person – so the more guests, the lower the per-head cost.

What's Included in the Price?

Every charter includes: licensed skipper, fuel, bottled water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). You can bring your own food and extra drinks. The skipper handles navigation and safety – you just enjoy.

How to Choose the Right Boat for a Stag Do

Consider group size and vibe. For a lively group of up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and is ideal for a party. The Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m) offers spacious deck areas. For a more intimate group, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are cost-effective. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you're steps from Marbella's nightlife.

Sample Budget Breakdown for 10 Guests

Let's say you book the Azimut 39 for 4 hours at €1,499 (price on request for 4h). That's €150 per person. Add your own food and drinks – maybe €20–30 per head. Total per person: around €170–180. Compare that to a club night, and you get a private boat, unlimited drinks, and a swim stop – far better value.

Best Time of Year for a Stag Boat Trip

Marbella enjoys over 300 sunny days a year. Peak stag season runs May to September, with sea temperatures reaching 24°C in August. Book early for weekends. Spring and autumn offer milder weather and lower demand – often easier to secure a boat. Winter charters are possible but less popular for swimming.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the cheapest boat for a stag weekend in Marbella?

The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 are the most affordable options, starting at €749 for 2 hours (9–11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and include skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks. Perfect for a short afternoon cruise.

How many guests can a stag boat hold?

Our fleet ranges from 5 to 12 guests. For a larger stag group (up to 12), choose the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or Ferretti 94. Smaller groups of 5–6 are well suited to the Speedboat or Red Tide.

What is included in the price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No extra fees – just show up.

Can we bring our own food or drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The boat provides a basic selection, but many stag groups prefer to customise the menu. Just let the skipper know in advance.

How long is a typical stag boat trip?

Most stag groups book between 2 and 6 hours. A 2-hour trip is great for a quick coastal cruise, while 4–6 hours allow time to anchor at a cove, swim, and enjoy lunch. Overnight charters are also possible on request.

Where do the boats depart from?

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella's iconic marina. It's easy to reach from Marbella town, and there are plenty of bars and restaurants nearby for pre- or post-boat drinks.

We monitor forecasts closely. If conditions are unsafe, we offer a full refund or reschedule to a better slot. Typically, Marbella enjoys 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare.
